js: (async()=>{const st=await (await fetch('http://127.0.0.1:8896/api/interactive/boards/board_default/state')).json();const live=st.state.cards.filter(c=>!c.deleted&&c.kind!=='reply');const src=live[0],dst=live[1];const el=document.querySelector('[data-card-id="'+src.id+'"]');const r=el.getBoundingClientRect();const sx=r.x+20,sy=r.y+20;el.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerdown',{bubbles:true,clientX:sx,clientY:sy,pointerId:31,buttons:1}));const tb=document.querySelector('[data-card-id="'+dst.id+'"]').getBoundingClientRect();const tx=tb.x+tb.width/2,ty=tb.y+tb.height/2;for(let i=1;i<=8;i++){window.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointermove',{bubbles:true,clientX:sx+(tx-sx)*i/8,clientY:sy+(ty-sy)*i/8,pointerId:31,buttons:1}))}await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,400));const hint=(document.body.innerText.match(/松开后合并成组/)||['（没有提示）'])[0];const before=(await (await fetch('http://127.0.0.1:8896/api/interactive/boards/board_default/state')).json()).state.groups.length;window.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerup',{bubbles:true,clientX:tx,clientY:ty,pointerId:31}));await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,2000));const after=(await (await fetch('http://127.0.0.1:8896/api/interactive/boards/board_default/state')).json()).state;return JSON.stringify({hint,groupsBefore:before,groupsAfter:after.groups.length,group:after.groups[after.groups.length-1]?{name:after.groups[after.groups.length-1].name,defaultName:after.groups[after.groups.length-1].defaultName,members:after.groups[after.groups.length-1].members.length}:null})})()
